declarations.rationale: Minister appositive/possessive dominates the complete dictionary; actual roles are country to person. This is the minister title, without an unsupported prime-minister/head-of-government assumption.

War/fight pathways P3/P6/P14/P17 comprise six rows, the largest coherent specific military-conflict family after inspecting all arguments. Borders, ambassadors, alliance/join and generic international relations remain competing meanings; no catchall is introduced.
